description: Figure 3 is a grouped bar chart that displays the sample count for different essay genres within two distinct sets: "Open" (Open-Ended) and "Cons." (Constrained). The horizontal axis lists four essay genres: Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository. The vertical axis, labeled "Sample Count," ranges from 0 to 120 in increments of 20. For each genre, there are two bars: a light blue bar representing the "Open" set and a light pink bar representing the "Cons." set. The specific sample counts are as follows: for Argumentative, the Open set has 79 samples and the Cons. set has 122; for Narrative, the Open set has 80 samples and the Cons. set has 87; for Descriptive, the Open set has 68 samples and the Cons. set has 100; and for Expository, the Open set has 62 samples and the Cons. set has 130. In all four genres, the sample count for the Constrained set is higher than that for the Open set.
